name: use_skill
description: Invoke a registered skill. Skills are prompt templates loaded from the skills/ directory. Returns the skill prompt text (with {{placeholder}} substitution from args). Available built-in skills: brainstorming, code-review, tdd, explain.

skill.description: Name of the skill to invoke.

args.description: Arguments to substitute into skill prompt placeholders (e.g. {topic: "react hooks"} for {{topic}}).
